Jordan (People Ops): Heads-up team 1026 attestation opens Tue 09:00 PT. Two quick asks: (1) everyone finishes the 12-min privacy microtraining, (2) each team uploads one SOC2-relevant artifact OR files a ticket assigning an evidence owner.
Jordan (People Ops): Deadline: 2026-09-15 17:00 PT. Portal + checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations (see '2026-window'). Use folder: /attestations/2026/<team>/.
Ava (Security): FYI auditors accept a ticket with owner+ETA as interim evidence. Sampled teams (~10%) will be asked for exports (IAM, KMS, backups).
Ravi (Eng): Quick Q  what specifically counts as an artifact? runbooks + IAM export ok?
Jordan (People Ops): Yep. Copyable examples:
- Runbook/playbook (PDF/MD)
- IAM access export (CSV)
- Backup manifest with timestamps
- KMS/key rotation export
- Change-control ticket with approvals or an evidence-owner ticket
Kelly (Sales): For customer-facing teams, we sometimes have docs with customer names. How do we upload that without leaking PII?
Legal (Hannah): Redact customer names or replace with internal IDs. If you need help, open a legal-redaction ticket and tag @Legal.
Ravi (Eng): We have a prod deploy Wed morning  can we request a short extension?
Jordan (People Ops): Extensions up to 72h for release conflicts. File ticket titled `Compliance extension - <team> - <reason>` and cc @Ava. Training still due on time.
Ops Bot: Microtraining assigned: "Privacy Refresher 2026"  link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026. Completion tracked automatically.
Compliance Bot: Automated reminders scheduled 72h/48h/24h before close. Teams with missing items will get DMs and an @here ping in #people-ops.
Ava (Security): If you submit a ticket as interim evidence, include owner, ETA and expected artifact type. That prevents escalations.
Ravi (Eng): Filed `eng - Attestation 2026 - owner: Ravi` with ETA 2026-09-14. Uploading runbook + IAM export to the team folder now.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks everyone  we'll post a 24h and 6h final reminder. If anyone needs help packaging artifacts, office hours Thu 12:00 PT with Security & Legal. :pray:
